propositions: Atlassian Document Format (ADF) is hardwired into the Cloud path while Data Center uses plain text/wiki markup, causing duplication in mapping logic between the two deployment types

A four-operation RichTextCodec Protocol (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) is needed to preserve distinct Cloud behavior where fit and normalize are composed in specific orders by different callers

The Protocol and WikiTextCodec must live in adapters/jira_family/ (which imports nothing from adapters/jira/), while AdfCodec must live in adapters/jira/rich_text_codec.py to enforce architectural import constraints

Exactly one real implementation of map_fields_to_remote must exist in the shared jira_family/outbound_mapper.py, with Cloud and Data Center backends injecting their respective codecs as a constructor dependency

ADF references must remain localized to adapters/jira/adf.py, adapters/jira/rich_text_codec.py, adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py (location-pinned), and the inbound path—zero ADF references allowed in jira_family/ or jira_datacenter/
